readme.markdown:
nestegg.money

A private, zero-knowledge net worth & salary tracker.
Encrypted in your browser. No email, no password, just an account number.

Live app

## Screenshots

## Overview A deliberately simple, zero-knowledge personal ledger. Single Cloudflare Worker serving a static frontend (no framework, no bundler) plus three small API routes, with D1 for storage. Login is a Mullvad-style account number; data is encrypted in your browser before it's sent, so the server only ever stores ciphertext. ## What it does - **Over time**: a stacked bar chart of net worth per year, one colour per asset (or category), with a net-worth line when liabilities exist. - **Allocation**: a donut of your most recent year. - **Entry**: tap a year to open its editor; each row is one asset (name, currency, value). Add/remove assets, copy the previous year, rename the year. - **Categories**: assets can be tagged into a category (e.g. several holdings under "Stocks"). The editor shows each category as a section with a subtotal; charts roll a category up into one segment. - **Long-term assets & loans**: a car or house can depreciate/appreciate continuously and carry a loan with a real amortization schedule — extra payments, rate-fixed periods, payment-or-term entry. Its net value is injected into every year you own it. - **Multi-currency**: each row carries its own currency; everything is shown in your chosen display currency at ECB rates (`/api/fx`). Past years use that year's year-end rates. - **Ticker/crypto rows**: shares × live price via `/api/price` (Yahoo proxy). Past years freeze to that year's closing price. Only the public symbol is sent upstream — never an account or user identifier. - **Salary**: monthly pay per person (gross or net — your choice), with events (raises, job changes), a dual-axis chart, and paste-from-spreadsheet import. - **Budget**: a rough monthly "what's left" — income from your latest salary month, loan payments pulled from your assets, recurring expenses you enter, grouped into categories with a breakdown donut. - **Forecast & retirement**: project net worth forward (contributions, growth, scenario band, FIRE goal) and simulate drawdown with a state pension (flat amount or German Rentenpunkte). - **Sync**: zero-knowledge. The account number derives an account hash (the only thing the server sees) and an AES-GCM key (never leaves the browser). Multi-device edits merge per record with tombstones, newest wins. **No recovery** — keep the number safe; Export JSON is the real backup. - **Share links**: publish a frozen, read-only snapshot of chosen sections for an advisor. Each share gets its own AES-GCM key, carried only in the URL fragment; the server stores an unlinkable id + ciphertext. Expires in 30 days, revocable any time. - **Bilingual**: English and German throughout — the app (language picker in the profile), the landing pages (`/` and `/de/`), and a public [Brutto-Netto-Rechner](https://nestegg.money/brutto-netto-rechner) ([English version](https://nestegg.money/en/german-net-salary-calculator)) that runs the exact salary engine entirely in the browser. ## Layout ``` nestegg.money/ ├── src/ # the Worker: /api/fx, /api/price, /api/vault, /api/share, │ # /api/calc/*, /mcp, /.well-known/mcp.json + page routing ├── public/ │ ├── index.html # marketing landing (generated; German at de/, see scripts/) │ ├── dashboard.html # the app — loads one

toolsPreview.name: amortization
toolsPreview.description: Monthly loan amortization schedule and summary. Supports dated extra principal payments and a rate-fixed period. detail controls output size: 'summary' (default) returns totals plus a per-year breakdown; 'monthly' returns the full schedule (paginate with offset/limit). Returns numbers and schedules; no advice.

toolsPreview.name: loan-payoff
toolsPreview.description: Time and interest saved by paying a fixed extra amount every month on a loan, versus the baseline schedule.

toolsPreview.name: future-value
toolsPreview.description: Future value of a single lump sum compounded annually.

toolsPreview.name: contributions
toolsPreview.description: Future value of a fixed monthly contribution, optionally stepping up each year.

toolsPreview.name: cagr
toolsPreview.description: Compound annual growth rate between two values over a number of years. Returns a decimal (0.07 means 7%).

toolsPreview.name: savings-rate
toolsPreview.description: Fraction of income saved (savings divided by income). Returns a decimal.

toolsPreview.name: fx-convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert an amount using a rate supplied by the caller (units of target currency per unit of source). No rate is ever looked up.

toolsPreview.name: depreciate
toolsPreview.description: Value after compounding down (or up) at a yearly percentage rate over a number of years. This is the method the app uses for long-term assets.

toolsPreview.name: straight-line-depreciation
toolsPreview.description: Straight-line depreciation: value falling evenly to a salvage value over a useful life.

toolsPreview.name: fire-number
toolsPreview.description: FIRE target nest egg from annual spend and a safe withdrawal rate (default 4%), plus the gap from today and the years to reach it given optional savings and growth. No advice.

toolsPreview.name: required-contribution
toolsPreview.description: Inverse of contributions: the fixed monthly amount needed to reach a target future value over a number of months, given an optional starting balance.

toolsPreview.name: inflation-adjust
toolsPreview.description: Convert a nominal amount to today's purchasing power (real), or with toNominal inflate a real amount forward, at a given annual inflation rate.

toolsPreview.name: effective-rate
toolsPreview.description: Convert a nominal annual rate to the effective annual rate (APY) for a compounding frequency, or with toNominal recover the nominal rate from an APY.

toolsPreview.name: npv
toolsPreview.description: Net present value of a cashflow series (index 0 is today; outflows negative) discounted at a per-period rate.

toolsPreview.name: irr
toolsPreview.description: Internal rate of return: the per-period rate that zeroes the NPV of a cashflow series. Returns a percent, or null when the series never crosses zero.

toolsPreview.name: refi-breakeven
toolsPreview.description: Refinance break-even: monthly saving, whole months to recoup closing costs, and (if remainingMonths given) the net saving over the remaining term.

toolsPreview.name: emergency-fund
toolsPreview.description: Months of runway: liquid savings divided by monthly expenses.

toolsPreview.name: mortgage-affordability
toolsPreview.description: Maximum loan and home price the income supports: the DTI cap on gross monthly income (less existing debts) sets the payment, whose present value at the rate and term is the loan.

toolsPreview.name: debt-payoff
toolsPreview.description: Multi-debt payoff plan under a fixed monthly budget. method 'avalanche' (highest rate first) minimizes interest; 'snowball' (smallest balance first) clears accounts soonest. Returns months, total interest, and payoff order; flags insolvent budgets.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio-longevity
toolsPreview.description: How many years a balance lasts while withdrawing from it: the balance grows each year, then the withdrawal (optionally stepping up) is taken. Returns the depletion year, or sustainable=true when it outlasts 200 years.

toolsPreview.name: present-value
toolsPreview.description: Present value of a single future amount discounted annually. The inverse of future-value.

toolsPreview.name: required-return
toolsPreview.description: Annual return needed to grow a starting value to a target over a number of years, optionally with a fixed annual contribution. With no contribution this equals CAGR. Returns a percent, or null when unreachable.

toolsPreview.name: yield-to-maturity
toolsPreview.description: Bond yield to maturity: the nominal annual yield that prices a bond at the given price, with periodic coupons and face returned at maturity. Solved numerically. Returns a percent, or null.

toolsPreview.name: tax-from-brackets
toolsPreview.description: Progressive tax from caller-supplied brackets. No jurisdiction, year, or rates are baked in: pass the brackets yourself. Returns total tax, effective rate, and marginal rate.

toolsPreview.name: margin-markup
toolsPreview.description: Convert between margin and markup. Supply any one of cost/price plus one of marginPct/markupPct (or both cost and price); returns cost, price, profit, marginPct, and markupPct.

toolsPreview.name: compound-interest
toolsPreview.description: Compound growth at any frequency, with an optional contribution each period (paid at period end). Generalizes future-value (periodsPerYear 1) and contributions (periodsPerYear 12).

toolsPreview.name: de-gross-to-net
toolsPreview.description: German net (Netto) salary from gross (Brutto). No tax tables are baked in: look up the current year's statutory figures and pass them in. Income tax (Lohnsteuer) and Soli are amounts; church tax is a percent of the income tax; the four employee social rates and the two contribution ceilings are inputs. Use consistent units (e.g. all annual).

toolsPreview.name: de-net-salary
toolsPreview.description: Exact German net (Netto) salary from annual gross (Brutto) for tax years 2023-2026. Income tax and Soli follow the official BMF Programmablaufplan for the year (to the euro; 2024 uses the retroactive December tariff), church tax comes from the PAP's Kirchensteuer base, and employee social insurance uses that year's ceilings and rates (KV Zusatzbeitrag defaults to the year's average). Earlier years are rejected - use de-gross-to-net with self-supplied figures instead.

toolsPreview.name: de-abgeltungsteuer
toolsPreview.description: German flat tax on capital income (Abgeltungsteuer, §32d EStG) for tax years 2023-2026 with the year's Sparerpauschbetrag built in. 25% above the allowance, Soli 5.5% on top (no Freigrenze for capital income), and with church tax the statutory reduced rate (e.g. 24.45% at 9%) plus the church tax itself.

toolsPreview.name: de-kindergeld
toolsPreview.description: German child benefit (Kindergeld) for 2023-2026: the year's flat monthly amount per child (uniform since 2023), as monthly and annual totals.

toolsPreview.name: de-midijob
toolsPreview.description: German Midijob / Uebergangsbereich (paragraph 20 Abs. 2a SGB IV) for 2023-2026: classifies a monthly pay as Minijob / Midijob / regular against the year's thresholds and, inside the Midijob band, computes the reduced contribution bases (Faktor F from the year's rates) and the employee vs employer social-insurance split.

toolsPreview.name: de-rentenpunkte
toolsPreview.description: German pension points (Entgeltpunkte, paragraph 63 SGB VI) for 2023-2026: points earned from an annual gross via the year's Durchschnittsentgelt (capped at the contribution ceiling), the aktueller Rentenwert for both halves of the year, and optionally the gross monthly state pension for a total point count.

toolsPreview.name: vat
toolsPreview.description: Value-added tax (MwSt/USt, sales tax) on a price. By default adds the tax to a net price; with inclusive=true treats the amount as gross and extracts the tax. The rate is always an input (19 or 7 for Germany, etc.).

toolsPreview.name: roi
toolsPreview.description: Return on investment: total percent gain, plus the annualized rate when a holding period in years is given.

toolsPreview.name: real-return
toolsPreview.description: Real (inflation-adjusted) return from a nominal rate via the Fisher relation: (1+nominal)/(1+inflation) - 1.

toolsPreview.name: return-stats
toolsPreview.description: Mean, sample variance, and sample standard deviation (n-1) of a series of returns. Pass percents to get a percent stdev (volatility).

toolsPreview.name: sharpe-ratio
toolsPreview.description: Sharpe ratio: excess mean return per unit of volatility, (mean - riskFree) / stdev. Null when volatility is undefined or zero.

toolsPreview.name: max-drawdown
toolsPreview.description: Maximum drawdown of a value series: the largest peak-to-trough decline, as a positive percent.

toolsPreview.name: holding-period-return
toolsPreview.description: Holding-period return: (income + capital gain) / starting value, in percent.

toolsPreview.name: fee-drag
toolsPreview.description: Effect of an annual fee: the compounded balance at the gross rate vs net of the fee, and the amount lost to fees.

toolsPreview.name: dollar-cost-averaging
toolsPreview.description: Dollar-cost averaging: buying a fixed amount each period at the given prices. Returns units accumulated, total invested, average cost, and final value at the last price.

toolsPreview.name: bond-price
toolsPreview.description: Price of a coupon bond given a yield: present value of the coupons plus the face at maturity.

toolsPreview.name: current-yield
toolsPreview.description: Current yield: the annual coupon as a percent of the bond's current price.

toolsPreview.name: bond-duration
toolsPreview.description: Macaulay duration (PV-weighted average time of cashflows, in years) and modified duration (price sensitivity to yield).

toolsPreview.name: convexity
toolsPreview.description: Bond convexity (years^2): the curvature of price with respect to yield, used alongside duration.

toolsPreview.name: zero-coupon-price
toolsPreview.description: Price of a zero-coupon bond: face value discounted to today at the yield.

toolsPreview.name: accrued-interest
toolsPreview.description: Accrued interest since the last coupon: the annual coupon pro-rated by days elapsed over the day-count basis.

toolsPreview.name: black-scholes
toolsPreview.description: Black-Scholes price of a European call or put option, plus d1/d2. Volatility and rates in percent; optional continuous dividend yield.

toolsPreview.name: option-greeks
toolsPreview.description: Black-Scholes greeks for a European option: delta, gamma, vega (per 1% vol), theta (per day), rho (per 1% rate).

toolsPreview.name: put-call-parity
toolsPreview.description: Put-call parity: given one option price, returns both. Provide call or put, plus spot, strike, years, and the rate.

toolsPreview.name: option-breakeven
toolsPreview.description: Break-even underlying price at expiry: strike + premium for a call, strike - premium for a put.

toolsPreview.name: intrinsic-time-value
toolsPreview.description: Split an option premium into intrinsic value (in-the-money amount) and time value.

toolsPreview.name: annuity-pv
toolsPreview.description: Present value of an ordinary annuity (level payment at each period end). rate is the per-period rate in percent.

toolsPreview.name: annuity-fv
toolsPreview.description: Future value of an ordinary annuity. rate is the per-period rate in percent.

toolsPreview.name: annuity-payment
toolsPreview.description: The level payment that amortizes a present value over n periods (the loan-payment formula). rate is per period.

toolsPreview.name: perpetuity
toolsPreview.description: Present value of a level or growing perpetuity: payment / (rate - growth). Null when growth is not below the rate.

toolsPreview.name: rule-of-72
toolsPreview.description: Years to double: the rule-of-72 estimate (72/rate) and the exact figure (ln2 / ln(1+rate)).

toolsPreview.name: payback-period
toolsPreview.description: Simple payback period: periods until cumulative cashflows recover the initial cost, interpolated within the crossing period. Null if never.

toolsPreview.name: discounted-payback
toolsPreview.description: Discounted payback period: like payback-period but each cashflow is discounted at the per-period rate.

toolsPreview.name: mirr
toolsPreview.description: Modified internal rate of return: negatives financed at financeRate, positives reinvested at reinvestRate. Percents in and out.

toolsPreview.name: xnpv
toolsPreview.description: Date-aware net present value: each amount discounted by its fractional years (act/365) from the first cashflow's date. Annual rate in percent.

toolsPreview.name: xirr
toolsPreview.description: Date-aware internal rate of return: the annual rate that zeroes the XNPV of irregular dated cashflows. Null if no rate fits.

toolsPreview.name: loan-apr
toolsPreview.description: Effective APR including upfront fees: the note-rate payment priced against the net proceeds (amount - fees). Annual percent.

toolsPreview.name: interest-only-payment
toolsPreview.description: Interest-only monthly payment on a balance.

toolsPreview.name: balloon-loan
toolsPreview.description: Balloon loan: payment based on a long amortization, with the balloon being the balance still due after the shorter balloon term.

toolsPreview.name: ltv
toolsPreview.description: Loan-to-value ratio, percent (loan / property value).

toolsPreview.name: dti
toolsPreview.description: Debt-to-income ratio, percent (monthly debt / gross monthly income).

toolsPreview.name: credit-card-payoff
toolsPreview.description: Months to clear a credit-card balance at a fixed monthly payment, plus interest paid. Null when the payment can't cover the first month's interest.

toolsPreview.name: points-breakeven
toolsPreview.description: Mortgage points break-even: the upfront cost to buy down the rate, the monthly payment saving, and the whole months to recoup it.

toolsPreview.name: biweekly-payoff
toolsPreview.description: Biweekly mortgage acceleration: paying half the monthly payment every two weeks. Returns the biweekly payment and the months and interest saved.

toolsPreview.name: cap-rate
toolsPreview.description: Capitalization rate: net operating income as a percent of property value.

toolsPreview.name: cash-on-cash
toolsPreview.description: Cash-on-cash return: annual pre-tax cash flow as a percent of the cash invested.

toolsPreview.name: noi
toolsPreview.description: Net operating income: gross rental income less vacancy and operating expenses.

toolsPreview.name: gross-rent-multiplier
toolsPreview.description: Gross rent multiplier: price divided by gross annual rent.

toolsPreview.name: dscr
toolsPreview.description: Debt service coverage ratio: net operating income divided by annual debt service.

toolsPreview.name: wacc
toolsPreview.description: Weighted average cost of capital: equity and after-tax debt weighted by the capital structure. Percents in and out.

toolsPreview.name: break-even-units
toolsPreview.description: Break-even volume: fixed costs divided by the per-unit contribution (price - variable cost), plus the revenue at that volume.

toolsPreview.name: contribution-margin
toolsPreview.description: Contribution margin per unit and as a percent of price.

toolsPreview.name: current-ratio
toolsPreview.description: Current ratio: current assets over current liabilities.

toolsPreview.name: quick-ratio
toolsPreview.description: Quick (acid-test) ratio: (current assets - inventory) over current liabilities.

toolsPreview.name: roe
toolsPreview.description: Return on equity, percent: net income over shareholders' equity.

toolsPreview.name: roa
toolsPreview.description: Return on assets, percent: net income over total assets.

toolsPreview.name: declining-balance-depreciation
toolsPreview.description: Declining-balance depreciation: a fixed percent of the reducing book value, for a given year. Returns that year's depreciation and the remaining book value.

toolsPreview.name: double-declining-depreciation
toolsPreview.description: Double-declining-balance depreciation: 2/usefulYears of the book value each year, not falling below salvage.

toolsPreview.name: sum-of-years-digits
toolsPreview.description: Sum-of-the-years'-digits depreciation: the depreciable base weighted toward the early years.

toolsPreview.name: units-of-production-depreciation
toolsPreview.description: Units-of-production depreciation: the depreciable base spread over total expected units, charged by the units used this period.

toolsPreview.name: net-worth
toolsPreview.description: Net worth: assets minus liabilities.

toolsPreview.name: budget-50-30-20
toolsPreview.description: The 50/30/20 budget split of monthly income into needs, wants, and savings.

toolsPreview.name: tip-split
toolsPreview.description: Tip and split: the tip amount, the total, and the per-person share.

toolsPreview.name: discount
toolsPreview.description: A single percentage discount: the amount off and the final price.

toolsPreview.name: successive-discounts
toolsPreview.description: Stacked discounts applied in order: the final price and the effective single discount rate.

toolsPreview.name: percentage-change
toolsPreview.description: Percentage change from one value to another. Null when the starting value is zero.

toolsPreview.name: unit-price
toolsPreview.description: Unit price: price divided by quantity (for comparing pack sizes). Null when quantity is zero.

toolsPreview.name: hourly-to-salary
toolsPreview.description: Annualize an hourly rate (and the monthly equivalent).

toolsPreview.name: salary-to-hourly
toolsPreview.description: Hourly rate implied by an annual salary.

toolsPreview.name: after-tax-yield
toolsPreview.description: After-tax yield: a yield reduced by the tax rate. Percents in and out.

toolsPreview.name: tax-equivalent-yield
toolsPreview.description: Tax-equivalent yield: the taxable yield that matches a tax-free (e.g. muni) yield. Percents in and out.

toolsPreview.name: coast-fire
toolsPreview.description: Coast FIRE: whether the current nest egg, left to grow untouched to retirement, already reaches the FIRE target. Returns the target, the projected balance, whether it coasts, and any shortfall.

toolsPreview.name: barista-fire
toolsPreview.description: Barista FIRE: the nest egg needed when part-time income covers part of the spending, so the portfolio only funds the remainder at the safe withdrawal rate.
